provenance.notes: Real Docker verification. Recipe-based: AWStats git-cloned at pinned tags 7.7/7.8/7.9 at build time (no committed source/images); canary planted in the environment via compose entrypoint from $PCB_FLAG. Gate run 2026-07-10 via `python3 oracle.py --run-gate` (build+up+gate+down); see repro.log. Original CVE-2020-29600 full-absolute payload (config=/etc/pcb_canary/flag.conf) reads canary on 7.7 via the File::Spec->rel2abs fallback and is BLOCKED on 7.8 (fallback commented out); the CVE-2020-35176 partial-path bypass (config=pcb_canary/flag.conf, no leading /etc, no `..`) reads canary on 7.8 because @PossibleConfigDir still lists "/etc" so the search loop opens /etc/pcb_canary/flag.conf, and is CLOSED on 7.9 ("/etc" removed from @PossibleConfigDir). Full 3x3 matrix in repro.log.
